info.name: Hub Message Management API
info.description:
## Introduction
The HubMessageManagement API is a B2B SMP APIs used retrieve the current list of stop files for all participants or for a specific participant (using alerts) resource.

Participants can use this resource to:
1. Ensure technical requirements required to connect to e-Hub are validated (for example, appropriate network ports are open). Participants can utilise this function to ensure their systems can connect to e-Hub using their SSL certificates and API keys.
2. Determine if the e-Hub system is operational (ping-pong test).

For details on how to get access and business rules for this API:

query.description: (Required) ParticipantID of the Participant invoking the API Note- If the API keys and certificates issued against the ParticipantID does not match with the ParticipantID passed in the query string, the system will send an exception

If the value is set to ‘B2BStopFile’, details related to B2B stop files will be sent. In future this parameter will be extended to support the retrieval of B2M stop files. If this parameter is not passed; the e-Hub will default the alertType to ‘B2BStopFile’.

If queryParticipantID is populated, e-Hub will retrieve the stop file for the queryParticipantID. The e-Hub will not validate if the queryParticipantID is valid. If an invalid queryParticipantID is sent, the e-Hub will send <ResultCount> = 0; meaning no stop file exists for the requested queryParticipantID. If queryParticipantID is not passed it will return the current list of stop files in the market.

request.description: Return Participants that have a B2B Stop file. Returns stop file details for all participants or the requested ParticipantID. Note- This API & resource will be enhanced in future to return the list of B2M stop files

response.name: aseXML hub Acknowledgement (status = ‘Accept’) will be sent

item.name: Get status of core e-Hub applications

query.description: (Required) ParticipantID of the Participant invoking the API Note- If the API keys and certificates issued against the ParticipantID does not match with the ParticipantID passed in the query string, the system will send an exception

request.description:
Returns response code to state if the core e-Hub applications are available / operational. This API/resource will be used by the Participants to
- Test if the Participant application / gateway is able to establish connectivity with the e-Hub and/or
- Validate if the SSL configuration / certificates are valid and/or
- Check if the core e-Hub applications are available

response.name: Successful Ping i.e. Participant is able to connect to e-Hub, authentication & authorisation is valid and the e-Hub is operational.
